name: 优质模板库 - 筛选/创建任务/查看进度全功能
description: 覆盖优质模板库全部功能点：4个筛选条件(模板来源/Seller ID/店铺名称/模板组ID)+洗图状态筛选+应用场景筛选+标签维度+创建任务4步流程+查看任务进度。

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder], input.ant-input'); const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select'); const labels = document.querySelectorAll('label, .ant-form-item-label, [class*=label], [class*=filter-title]'); return { inputCount: inputs.length, inputs: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,type:i.type})), selectCount: selects.length, selectTexts: Array.from(selects).map(s=>s.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item,.ant-select-selection-placeholder')?.textContent?.trim()||''), labels: Array.from(labels).map(l=>l.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,15) }; })()
steps.description: 探查全部筛选组件: 模板来源/Seller ID/店铺名称/模板组ID

steps.expression: (() => { const filters = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=filter], [class*=status], [class*=wash], .ant-radio-group, .ant-tabs'); const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-button-wrapper, .ant-tabs-tab'); return { filterCount: filters.length, tabTexts: Array.from(tabs).map(t=>t.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10), hasWashStatus: Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll('*')).some(el => /洗图状态/.test(el.textContent)) }; })()
steps.description: 探查洗图状态筛选(可能为Radio/Tab形式)

steps.expression: (() => { const hasAppScene = Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll('*')).some(el => /应用场景/.test(el.textContent)); const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item'); return { hasAppSceneFilter: hasAppScene, selectValues: Array.from(selects).map(s=>s.textContent.trim()) }; })()

(() => { const dims = ['设计','搭配','拍摄','场景','光影','构图','视觉']; const tags = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=tag], .ant-tag, [class*=dimension]'); return { tagCount: tags.length, tagTexts: Array.from(tags).map(t=>t.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,15), dimFound: dims.map(d => ({dim:d, found: Array.from(tags).some(t=>t.textContent.includes(d))})) }; })()
steps.description: 探查7维度标签是否渲染

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, .ant-btn, a')); const found = btns.filter(b => /任务进度|查看任务|进度/.test(b.textContent)); return { found: found.length > 0, buttons: found.map(b => ({text:b.textContent.trim(), class:b.className?.substring(0,50), tag:b.tagName})), url: window.location.href }; })()
steps.description: 查找'查看任务进度'按钮并记录当前URL

steps.text: /(任务进度|查看任务|查看进度)/

fallback.expression: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,.ant-btn,a')).find(x => /任务进度|查看任务/.test(x.textContent)); if(b){b.click();return 'clicked';} return 'not found'; })()

steps.description: 等待任务进度弹窗/页面加载

steps.expression: (() => { const url = window.location.href; const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); const container = modal || drawer || document.querySelector('main, .ant-layout-content'); if(!container) return {type:'unknown', url}; const isModal = !!modal; const isDrawer = !!drawer; const tables = container.querySelectorAll('.ant-table, table'); const columns = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-thead th')).map(th=>th.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean); const rows = container.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]'); const progressBars = container.querySelectorAll('.ant-progress, [class*=progress]'); const statusTags = container.querySelectorAll('.ant-tag, [class*=tag]'); return { type: isModal?'modal':isDrawer?'drawer':'page', url, hasTable: tables.length>0, columns, rowCount: rows.length, hasProgressBar: progressBars.length>0, progressTexts: Array.from(progressBars).map(p=>p.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5), statusTags: Array.from(statusTags).map(t=>t.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10), firstRowData: rows.length ? rows[0].innerText.substring(0,200) : '', textSnippet: container.textContent.substring(0,500) }; })()
steps.description: 深度探查任务进度结构: Modal/Drawer/页面+表格列名+进度条+状态标签+首行数据

steps.expression: (() => { const container = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden), .ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden), main'); if(!container) return {}; const rows = container.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]'); return { taskCount: rows.length, tasks: Array.from(rows).slice(0,3).map(r => { const cells = r.querySelectorAll('td'); return { name: cells[0]?.innerText?.trim()?.substring(0,40) || '', status: Array.from(cells).find(c => /进行中|已完成|待开始|失败/.test(c.innerText))?.innerText?.trim() || '', progress: Array.from(cells).find(c => /\d+%|\d+\/\d+/.test(c.innerText))?.innerText?.trim() || '', time: Array.from(cells).find(c => /\d{4}-\d{2}/.test(c.innerText))?.innerText?.trim() || '' }; }) }; })()
steps.description: 提取前3个任务数据: 任务名/状态/进度/时间

steps.contains: /(任务|进度|进行中|已完成|待开始|任务名称)/
steps.description: 验证任务进度页含任务相关字段

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); return { modalClosed: !modal, drawerClosed: !drawer }; })()

(() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=card],[class*=template],[class*=thumb]'); const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]'); return { cardCount: cards.length, checkboxCount: checkboxes.length, hasCreateBtn: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,.ant-btn')).some(b=>/创建任务/.test(b.textContent)) }; })()

开始网络抓包-监控创建任务API

steps.expression: (() => { const m=document.querySelector('.ant-modal,.ant-drawer,main'); if(!m) return {found:false}; const cards=m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card,[class*=template],[class*=thumb]'); const inputs=m.querySelectorAll('input,textarea'); const selects=m.querySelectorAll('.ant-select,select'); return {found:true, templateCards:cards.length, inputs:Array.from(inputs).map(i=>i.placeholder).filter(Boolean), selectCount:selects.length, buttons:Array.from(m.querySelectorAll('button,.ant-btn')).map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean)}; })()

(() => { const m=document.querySelector('.ant-modal,.ant-drawer,main'); if(!m) return {}; const inputs=m.querySelectorAll('input,textarea'); const selects=m.querySelectorAll('.ant-select,select'); return { step2Inputs: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,value:i.value,type:i.type})), step2Selects: selects.length }; })()
